stem: What critical catalytic task do almost all enzymes perform inside cells?

options.label: A
options.text: Replace ATP as the universal energy currency

options.label: B
options.text: Change the equilibrium constant of reactions
options.misconception: Enzymes speed rates; they do not alter delta-G equilibrium.

options.label: C
options.text: Lower the activation energies of chemical reactions
options.explanation: OpenStax: enzymes lower activation energies of cellular reactions.

options.label: D
options.text: Supply the net free energy for endergonic processes without coupling
options.misconception: Endergonic work still needs energetic coupling.

context: Learning objective: enzymes lower activation energy.
imageCaption: Enzymes lower Ea; competitive inhibitors bind active site; allosteric ligands bind elsewhere; glycolysis regulated at key steps.
